name: Accurate
description: When aiming, gain +10 to hit and add extra damage dice equal to floor(DoS / 2).

name: Inaccurate
description: Aim stance provides no bonus to hit with this weapon.

name: Balanced
description: +10 to Parry checks when using this weapon to parry.

name: Unbalanced
description: -10 to Parry checks when using this weapon to parry; Swift Attack is not allowed.

name: Unwieldy
description: Cannot be used to parry; Swift Attack is not allowed.

name: Flexible
description: Attacks made with this weapon cannot be parried (dodge still allowed).

name: Tearing
description: Roll one extra d10 for damage and discard the lowest.

name: Razor Sharp
description: If attack DoS is 3+, double weapon penetration for this attack.

name: Felling
description: Reduce target Toughness Bonus by X for soak on this attack.

name: Force
description: If the wielder has the weaver trait, add PM to damage and penetration for this attack.

name: Vengeful
description: On critical hits, roll best-of-X for damage dice (minimum 2).

name: Shocking
description: On hit, inflicts 1d5 fatigue and stunned for ceil(DoS / 2) rounds.

name: Toxic
description: Target must pass a Toughness test at -10 per rank or suffer 1d10 direct damage.

name: Sanctified
description: Counts as magical vs daemonic-spiritual targets and triggers spiritual instability test.

name: Magic Field
description: On successful parry, may destroy the attacking weapon (unless it is magical or natural).

name: Magic Fueled
description: Ranged weapon fueled by magic; uses WIL for attacks and can generate multiple hits.

name: Simple
description: A basic weapon with no special combat effects.

name: Primitive
description: Crude construction; the damage dice result is capped at X before bonuses.

name: Proven
description: Masterwork; the damage dice result has a minimum of X before bonuses.
